name: Cycles without clumps: A coreless étale correspondence in characteristic two
abstract: An explicit symmetric degree-25 finite étale self-correspondence of a genus-two curve in characteristic two. It is minimal, coreless and clump-free, while its generic graph contains K5,5 and is not three-arc-transitive. The diagonal cyclic base-change family remains symmetric; independently chosen mixed-endpoint families yield K_{n,m} subgraphs and may have different endpoint genera.
